title: Running Late

conversation.speaker: Ava
conversation.text: Did you hear about the subway delays? The morning train schedule is so volatile right now.

conversation.speaker: Eve
conversation.text: I know, we've only had sporadic updates on the app, leaving us guessing when the next train is coming.

conversation.speaker: Ava
conversation.text: The crowd at the station platform was daunting. There must have been hundreds of people squeezed together.

conversation.speaker: Eve
conversation.text: I'm always wary of boarding those packed trains; it's so easy to drop your phone or bag.

conversation.speaker: Ava
conversation.text: We had to transition to a bus route, which took twice as long.

conversation.speaker: Eve
conversation.text: I tried to emulate those people who read books calmly during commute delays, but I was too stressed.

conversation.speaker: Ava
conversation.text: Trying to stay calm is futile when you have an important meeting at nine.

conversation.speaker: Eve
conversation.text: Our boss has an implicit expectation that we should arrive on time, regardless of transit issues.

conversation.speaker: Ava
conversation.text: True, though the inherent unpredictability of public transport should be taken into account.

conversation.speaker: Eve
conversation.text: Let's give him a lucid explanation of what happened so he understands it wasn't our fault.

conversation.speaker: Ava
conversation.text: Good idea. Any subsequent lateness this week might make us look unprofessional.

conversation.speaker: Eve
conversation.text: Yes, and a superficial apology won't cut it if it happens again. We should leave fifteen minutes earlier tomorrow.

conversation.speaker: Ava
conversation.text: Agreed. Let's head into the office now.

vocabulary.meaning: liable to change rapidly and unpredictably
occurring at irregular intervals or only in few places; scattered
seeming difficult to deal with in anticipation; intimidating
feeling or showing caution about possible dangers or problems
the process of changing from one state, route, or condition to another
imitate or copy, typically to match or surpass a standard of behavior
pointing to an effort that is pointless or useless
implied though not plainly expressed; absolute and unquestioning
existing in something as a permanent, essential, or characteristic attribute
coming after something in time; following
existing or occurring only at the surface; not thorough or deep

takeaway: Commuting delays are stressful and volatile, but a lucid explanation and early planning help manage professional expectations.
